title: US Announces New 25% Tariff on Brazilian Imports Over 'Unfair Trade Practices'
detail: USTR Jamieson Greer announced a 25% Section 301 tariff on most Brazilian imports following a year-long investigation into Brazilian digital trade rules, ethanol market access, and deforestation policy, effective July 22. Coffee, beef, avocados, Brazil nuts, petroleum oils, and aircraft parts are exempted. Brazilian President Lula da Silva called the tariffs 'illegal and arbitrarily imposed' and vowed countermeasures under Brazil's Reciprocity Law plus a WTO challenge.

media.caption: US announces 25% Section 301 tariff on Brazilian imports

title: Trump Overturns DHS Pause on ICE Vehicle Stops After Two Fatal Shootings
detail: Following two fatal ICE shootings within a week — Lorenzo Salgado Araujo in Houston on July 7 and Johan Sebastian Duran Guerrero in Biddeford, Maine — DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin briefly ordered agents to suspend most routine vehicle stops pending a procedure review. Trump publicly reversed the pause less than 24 hours later, calling traffic stops 'one of ICE's most important and effective Crime Fighting tools' and criticizing the pause on Truth Social.

media.caption: Trump overturns DHS pause on ICE vehicle stops after two fatal shootings
